game.name: Gears of War : Judgment (Europe)(En,Ru)
game.desc: Gears of War: Judgment is the latest installment of the legendary franchise on the Xbox 360. Again offering a campaign fully playable in cooperation with 4 players, it is a prequel set 15 years before the first Gears of War trilogy, with the ability to unlock a bonus mission narrating events happening during the Gears 3 campaign. Two new multiplayer modes are included, Overrun and Free-for-All.
